Lets MatChat\'s own right softkey (Options or Back, depending on Settings > Advanced > Swap Left/Right keys) work while typing a message, on phones whose predictive-text keyboard would otherwise capture it first. Reads only the right softkey press — nothing else, never your typing, never the screen.\n\nStill not working after turning this on? Only one app\'s accessibility service can win a given key press — check Settings > Accessibility for any other keyboard or key-logging service and turn it off too. On Android 13 and up, this switch can also silently fail to take effect for a sideloaded app like this one until you allow it: open Settings > Apps > MatChat, use the overflow menu for \"Allow restricted settings,\" then try turning this on again.
